existing.description: The Jefferson Scholarship is a merit award of the Jefferson Scholars Foundation that funds the entire cost of attendance for four years of undergraduate study at the University of Virginia, plus supplemental enrichment experiences. Virginians receive over $42,000 per year (upwards of $230,000 total) and non-Virginians over $83,000 per year (upwards of $405,000 total). Students cannot apply individually: invited secondary schools nominate a senior through the Foundation's nomination portal, with materials due December 1 for all regions. Regional review and interviews run mid-December through January, final virtual interviews take place in late February, and recipients must accept by mid-April.
eligibility: High school senior (or equivalent final year) with exceptional record.
Demonstrate excellence in leadership, scholarship, and engaged citizenship.
Must be nominated by an eligible high school (U.S. schools in invited regions or international partner schools).
Must gain admission to University of Virginia through regular admissions process.
International students from countries with partner programs must be nominated through those schools.
existing.eligibility_summary: Exceptional high school seniors demonstrating excellence in leadership, scholarship, and engaged citizenship; must be nominated by eligible high school (U.S. schools or international partner schools); must gain admission to University of Virginia separately.
benefits: Full tuition, fees, room, and board for four years
Supplemental enrichment experiences (travel, leadership institutes, career development)
For non-Virginians: over $83,000 per year, upwards of $405,000 total

application_method: Nomination-only through eligible high school; no direct individual application. Must also apply to UVA through regular admissions.
existing.selection_notes: Three main components: Nomination, Regional Selection and Final Selection. Regional Selection Committees of alumni and friends review transcripts, extracurricular activities, essays and recommendations before determining who is interviewed; interview rounds determine the finalists who are invited to compete in late February. The University of Virginia Office of Undergraduate Admission also conducts an additional review of Early applicants and may recommend nominees, who are notified in February. Winners visit Charlottesville to explore the University before deciding.

existing.notes: No direct application — only nominated students are considered. Approximately 36 scholars selected annually from ~3,000 nominations. SAT/ACT not considered for 2026-27 selection. Must be admitted to UVA separately to receive scholarship. International students eligible through partner schools in eligible countries.

scholarships.title: University of Minnesota Global Excellence Scholarship

existing.funding_period: per year for up to four years
existing.description: The Global Excellence Scholarship (GES) is a competitive, merit-based award for international freshmen and transfer students at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities. All admitted freshmen studying on an F-1 visa who complete their admission application by the published deadlines are automatically reviewed, and admitted transfer students on an F-1 visa who complete by the priority deadline are automatically considered; there is no separate scholarship application. The award is partial - the University states it does not offer a full tuition waiver or scholarship - and the University's International Undergraduate Fact Book states the value as up to $15,000 each year for up to four years. Deadlines follow admission: Early Action I November 1, Early Action II December 1, Regular January 1. Applicants on temporary visas must also complete the Certification of Finances form.
eligibility: Freshmen or transfer student admitted to University of Minnesota Twin Cities.
Strong academic merit (top of high school class, record of strong academic preparation).
Must maintain F-1 status to renew.
existing.eligibility_summary: International freshmen or transfer students on F-1 visa; strong academic merit; automatic consideration upon completing admission application by deadline.
